headline: VLTO Q2 Deep Dive: Data Center Tailwinds and Industrial Growth Drive Outlook
summary: Water analytics and treatment company Veralto (NYSE:VLTO) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 7.5% year on year to $1.47 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.11 per share was 10.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
